a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The visitors explain which motifs are personal or restricted.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The hosts learn that admiration does not mean permission to copy.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The artists create new motifs inspired by shared island life.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They agree to keep their traditions distinct.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some participants choose to observe instead.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The artists discover that similar shapes can carry different meanings.
